seller_or_subject: Blog 13-year vintage seller reports four months below-normal sales
what: 13-year Etsy seller with 700 listings and Star Seller status reports four consecutive months of below-normal sales and sets 2025 as a "litmus test" for whether to close the shop.
verbatim_snippet: "my Etsy sales are still well-below normal for the fourth month in a row. I can't just write it off as a blip anymore. I'm coming up on my 13th year of selling vintage stuff on Etsy with 700 interesting items and Star Seller Status so my sales should be rock solid. But they just aren't."
notes: Page loaded and text confirmed by research agent. Author: Karen, Lion and Lamb Vintage. 13 years tenure, 700 listings, Star Seller, vintage products, US-based. Date is January 14, 2025 — outside the April 2025 time window. Degraded to Part 4 solely for date noncompliance. A commenter (Heather Spiva, 15 years on Etsy) noted shifting to higher-priced items (~$78 avg vs $38 prior) resulted in improved profitability despite fewer listings — captured as additional context but not a separate finding due to date exclusion.
